description.value: Sells a 'Revenue AI OS' for revenue teams. It captures customer interactions, analyzes what's working, and automates next steps.
AI revenue intelligence company founded in 2015 by Amit Bendov and Eilon Reshef; originally incorporated in Israel.
Revenue intelligence platform for B2B sales and revenue operations teams.

product_description.value: Gong Engage (sales engagement), Gong Forecast (revenue forecasting), Gong Enable (revenue enablement), Gong Agents (automates follow-ups, pipeline edits, enablement triggers and forecast corrections), Gong Revenue Graph, and Gong Collective (partner integrations and services).

business_model_description.value: Quote-based with no public list prices. Pricing combines per-user licenses (a Foundation core license plus add-ons such as Engage and Forecast), a platform fee, and a one-time onboarding fee.

customer_description.value: Reports 5,000+ customers in technology, financial services, healthcare and manufacturing; buyers are CROs, RevOps, sales, customer success and enablement teams. Named customers include Anthropic, ADP, HubSpot, LinkedIn, Uber for Business, Sprout Social, SurveyMonkey and Frontline Education.
More than 4,500 companies around the world rely on Gong (AWS Marketplace listing).

founded_year.value: 2015 (founded by Amit Bendov and Eilon Reshef)
